info.title: DNDWORLDAPP API
info.description:
Self-hosted worldbuilding and campaign API.

Two ways to authenticate: a `dwa_session` cookie for the browser, or
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` for scripts and the MCP server.

A token acts as its owner and inherits that user's role in each world.
Scopes and the optional world pin only ever *narrow* that — a token can
never grant more than the person holding it has.

Things the caller may not see answer 404 rather than 403, so ids cannot
be probed to discover hidden content.

This document is generated from the Zod schemas in packages/schema.

get.summary: The world as a graph of pages and the ways they connect
get.description: Nodes are the live pages the viewer can read; edges are relations, link-type fields, wiki links, map pins (marker visibility and fog applied) and parent/child structure, each only when both ends and the edge itself are visible to the viewer. With `focus`, only pages within `depth` hops of that page (structure edges don't count as hops); an unknown or hidden focus returns an empty graph. Capped at 5000 nodes, keeping the most connected; `truncated` says when that happened.

parameters.description: Node id to center a neighborhood on.

parameters.description: With `focus`: `1` counts a shared tag as a step (page → #tag → page), `0` walks edges only.

401.description: Not signed in, or the token is unknown, revoked or expired

403.description: Signed in, but not allowed — including a token missing a scope

404.description: Not found. Also returned for things the caller may not see, so ids cannot be probed.
